app.title: Wishka
app.tagline: A wishlist you'll love to share

meta.description: A wishlist you'll love to share: paste a link and the card builds itself, while friends reserve gifts without you ever seeing it.

code.expired: The code expired — request a new one

list.emptyTitle: The first entry is up to you

form.dreamHint: A big dream — something people save up or chip in for

groups.emptyTitle: Groups — the lists of the people close to you, in one place

groups.haveInviteHint: Open the link from the email or message — it leads straight into the group.

groups.leaveBody: Wishes visible only to this group will become unavailable to it.
groups.deleteBody: The group disappears for every member. Wishes visible only to it will become unavailable to them.
groups.removeBody: Wishes visible only to this group will become unavailable to them.

invite.title: You're invited to "{name}"
invite.body: Sign in to join — members' lists will show up under People.

profile.nicknameWarning: The old link will stop working

publicList.emptyOwnerHint: Check "Good to know" — there are gift hints there.

share.title: Share
share.restrictedWarningTitle: This wish isn't visible to everyone
share.restrictedWarningBody: Even with the direct link, only the people it's shared with can open it.

params.fillHint: Fill this in so people can pick better gifts for you
params.publicNote: Anyone with the link can see your profile — it's public to whoever you send it to

reserve.confirmBody: We won't tell anyone 😉 The owner will never know the gift is taken.
reserve.unreserveBody: The wish will become available to others again.
reserve.conflictTitle: Oh no, someone just took it
reserve.conflictBody: Someone got there first — see what's still available.
reserve.otherDeviceHint: Was it you who reserved it? Open the link from your email to pick it up on this device.
reserve.guestNameRequired: Tell us your name — that's how we'll remember the reservation
reserve.guestEmailHint: We'll send a confirmation and a link to manage the reservation
reserve.guestEmailInvalid: Looks like a typo in the address
reserve.successTitle: Done! We'll remember you on this device
reserve.successBody: The owner won't know a thing — reservations are visible only to the list's guests.
reserve.successEmailPrompt: Leave your email — we'll send a link to manage the reservation from any device
reserve.successEmailSaved: Done — the email is on its way
reserve.switchBody: This device already holds another guest's reservations. Switching makes those unreachable here — you'll only be able to get them back via the link in your own email.

myReservations.title: My reservations
myReservations.empty: Gifts you reserve will show up here.
myReservations.emailsNote: We email you about owner changes
myReservations.mergeFound: {count, plural, one {Found # guest reservation of yours — move it to your account?} other {Found # guest reservations of yours — move them to your account?}}

visibility.title: Who can see it
visibility.noGroupsHint: Create a group and you can open a wish to everyone in it at once.
visibility.noPeople: Nobody to pick yet — invite people to a group first
visibility.emptyAudience: Pick at least one — otherwise only you will see this wish
visibility.narrowNote: If narrowing this takes the wish away from someone who reserved it, their reservation stays theirs and we email them.

partner.title: Partner
partner.hint: Your partner always comes first in "Who can see it"
partner.empty: A partner is picked from the members of your groups

viewAs.title: How others see it
viewAs.bannerGuest: Preview: as a guest sees it
viewAs.note: Reservations are never shown in a preview

account.deleteBody: Your list, archive and profile will be deleted. Groups you administer pass to their other members — and disappear with you if you're the only one left. Reservations you made on other people's lists are released, and reservations other people made on your wishes disappear along with your list. This cannot be undone.

service.invalidLinkTitle: This link is invalid or the list was deleted
service.noAccessTitle: This list is only visible to group members
